Summary of a Trial Comparison

Source: R/class_trial_comparison.R
TrialComparisonSummary.Rd

A snapshot of comparison profiles and display settings, created by summary.TrialComparison() or compare().

Details

Inherits from SummaryFactory and ParameterSet. Each resolved summary input is classified centrally as a default or user-defined parameter. getObjectRCode() includes only user-defined inputs unless includeDefaultParameters = TRUE. Settings resolved from R options or environment variables are retained when they differ from package defaults. showAll affects rendering without replacing the stored limits or text mode. The underlying comparison is retained by reference, whereas profiles and display labels are snapshots. Recompute the summary after changing objects.

Fields

parameterInfo

A data frame of derived parameter metadata, exact profiles and object group IDs, with one row per comparison parameter. Profiles retain their stage and situation coordinates.

digits

Number of digits supplied for display rounding; NA leaves values unrounded. Is a single numeric value representing a whole number.

maxParameters

Maximum number of differing parameters displayed; defaults to 12. Ignored for display when showAll is TRUE. Is a single numeric value representing a whole number.

maxProfiles

Maximum number of distinct profiles displayed per parameter; defaults to 3. Ignored for display when showAll is TRUE. Is a single numeric value representing a whole number.

maxObjects

Maximum number of object names or numbers displayed per profile; defaults to 6. Ignored for display when showAll is TRUE. Is a single numeric value representing a whole number.

maxValues

Maximum number of values displayed per profile preview; defaults to 4. Ignored for display when showAll is TRUE. Is a single numeric value representing a whole number.

harmonizeColumnNames

Whether the snapshot uses harmonized comparison column names; defaults to TRUE. Is a single logical value.

textMode

Resolved console text handling: wrap, truncate or full. Defaults to wrap; showAll disables truncation without changing this stored input. Is a single character value.

width

Resolved console line width in characters, at least 20. Taken from the supplied value, comparison setting or the R width option (fallback 80). Is a single numeric value representing a whole number.

showAll

Whether all profiles, objects and values are displayed without the max limits or text truncation; defaults to FALSE. Stored limits remain unchanged. Is a single logical value.

object

The underlying TrialComparison object, retained by reference.

title

Derived comparison summary title. Is a single character value.

header

Inherited optional summary header; NULL for comparison summaries.

summaryItems

Inherited list of summary items; empty for comparison summaries, which render parameterInfo directly.

intervalFormat

Inherited interval format string, initially [%s; %s]; comparison profile rendering does not use this field. Is a single character value.

justify

Inherited alignment setting resolved from the summary configuration, with default right. Is a single character value.

output

Selected summary sections: all, title, overview or body; defaults to all. Is a single character value.

markdown

Inherited Markdown output flag, initially FALSE. Is a single logical value.

See also

getComparison(), compare()
